sentences.text: UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R T h e p e t i t i o n e r i s a n a c c u s e d f o r t h e o f f e n c e s p u n i s h a b l e u n d e r S e c t i o n s 454/380/420/468/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code.
His bail/default bail application was dismissed by the High Court.
He has already undergone about 1 year and 10 months in jail.
Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, State and the complainant, we are of the opinion that a case of bail is made out for the petitioner.
Even it has been stated by Mr. Hemant Gulati, learned counsel for the complainant, that presently compromise has been going on between the parties.
Under these circumstances, we feel that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
The present petition shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)
